description: Hi, I'm Jana Wael.. I'm interested in space science, technology, and creative ideas. I'm very proud of my team, and I'm excited for us to build an awesome project together
summary: The Challenge: This challenge aims to introduce children and young people to the spacecraft and equipment launched by NASA and left in various locations within the solar system, such as the Moon, Mars, and deep space. It also introduces the stories of these spacecraft, their missions, and the scientific discoveries they contributed to, all in a simple and engaging way suitable for their age. Our Solution: In short, we decided to create an interactive website that introduces children to spacecraft in a fun and exciting way. The website features short videos for each spacecraft, in which it tells its own story, recounts its journey, and describes the missions it has performed, as if it were speaking directly to the child. The videos are designed in an attractive style suitable for both children and adults. To add an element of challenge and interaction, after each video, three questions about the spacecraft appear. Children must answer these questions correctly to earn points, encouraging them to learn and discover more about the world of space.
details: The website includes several pages: a page for choosing a character (with the name below it), a page for choosing where the child wants to go (the moon or Mars), and then videos, questions, and points.
